notes.title: Full Release – Patch 1.0.0 is live!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, operatives![/p][p][/p][p]It was about an 8-month journey from patch 0.1.0 to 1.0.0. Time flies, huh? Overall we're happy with the result, as this is the first serious project for our two-man team. We met a lot of great people and received wonderful support, so thank you all![/p][p][/p][p]We are going to take a break until September, and afterward we'll decide if we're going to continue supporting C.A.S.T. with new content. It mostly depends on how well the game performs in the next few weeks. Regardless of our decision, we will continue fixing any crucial bugs both during and after the break.[/p][p][/p][p]Now let's see what we have for you in the 1.0.0 patch.[/p][h3]
Added[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Side Objective[/b]: Destroy Flower of Infestation. This boss appears in a random location on the map and surrounds itself with walls made of roots and flowers that emit dangerous gas. It also summons flying enemies that explode upon contact with the player.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/d17b15b6c3d10c4fb30a4a7888380711664dc8d3.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Side Objective[/b]: Destroy Cultists' Airship. This boss appears in a random location and flies around the map, shooting at the player with .50-cal turrets and rocket turrets. It also drops a huge napalm bomb.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/91f4646f57059e0f91f088d249f56830d190e13f.png"][/img][/p][p]Both bosses drop high and low samples, and their danger scales with the selected difficulty.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Common Modifier[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/3d8b75b8dcde1d4f854ed939140dc467bb6d1913.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Modifier[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/11bfa536e5c0c63378db468518380095657e65eb.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Modifier[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/449423dd5f50b68e94d58c39601e9ffc02dbbe35.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added a toggle sprint option to the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added borders to each map so it's easier to see where the map ends.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Starting items now auto-equip and automatically assign to quick slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the sound of the .50-cal turret on the van.[/p][/*][*][p]Double-barrel shotguns and OGNESTVOL now load two rounds at once, increasing their overall reload speed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the medallion counter could show incorrect progress in the swamp location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Kogteron's attack sensors. Previously, you could walk very close to him without triggering an attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Kogteron's achievements sometimes wouldn't unlock upon killing him.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Molotov would sometimes clip through terrain.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Content & Roadmap Update
notes.content:
Greetings, operatives!

We wanted to share an update on our upcoming plans. This time around, we’re likely skipping smaller patches like 0.6.x and instead focusing directly on [b]patch 0.7.0[/b], which will include a bunch of new content: exotec, weapons, and of course, a new van with upgrade options. We're also planning to introduce an [b]Uber version of Koldunak[/b] to keep higher difficulties challenging.

Also, we’ve adjusted the roadmap based on our available resources. A big part of this is due to the ongoing personal issue we've mentioned in previous posts. We know it's frustrating and trust us, it's for us too but it’s not something that can be quickly resolved, even with a break. Some of the content we cut or replaced from the roadmap may be added after full release if the game performs well.

Thanks for sticking with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/2f01e67e07d54333a3313a23b09aa650bcc733b7.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Patch 0.6.0 is out!
notes.content:
Greetings, operatives!

Patch 0.6.0 is out! This update brings a new location, quality of life features, and a network engine update.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] New location: [b]Beast's Core[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/aaf8b90716aca7737f689c5d21b15ddee7d2f4c9.png[/img]
[*] Ping system (Default: Middle Mouse Button)
[*] Added a button to dismantle Modifiers into Samples.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Koldunak been reworked to be a more aggressive, engagement-focused enemy, rather than passively wandering the map.
[*] Quick Slot Auto-Equip: For example, if you use your last bandage and a teammate drops you another, picking it up will automatically slot it into the same slot and equip it into your hands if they're empty.
[*] You can now rebind the controls for cycling through quick slots (Default: Mouse Wheel).
[*] Updated the underlying network engine. This foundational change should improve stability and help prevent certain network-related bugs long-term.
[/list]

This patch is a bit smaller on the content side than we initially planned. Expect an announcement regarding our next steps by the next monday!

notes.title: Major Patch 0.5.0 is out!
notes.content:
Greetings, operatives!  

Patch 0.5.0 is finally here! While we’ve completed most of our goals for this update, some features, such as weapon and modifier balancing and second abilities for each character, were cut and will arrive in future updates.  

[b]Added[/b]  
[list]
[*] 5 new difficulty levels, along with a general rebalance of all difficulty levels.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/03e9b16623fc08878346c99465242dca6ee64578.png[/img]
[*] 5 new uber enemies.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/dfb299447eeacb0e0c7d56343a4c48c9bd1309a2.png[/img]
[*] Each character now has an active ability that charges by killing enemies.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/7aa5da78112bb6d7ea517866a94e6933f2d31f9e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/745292a35a47682dfc1cf53df20f5706ad275c82.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/b623174f51e2a3f1370f5a1a04bec2102fe000ba.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205179/72dd4b4ab075b789a9a8bd2bbd6ae2f920074b9c.png[/img]
[*] Replaced Rookie character with a Scavenger.
[/list]  

[b]Changes[/b]  
[list]
[*] Anomalies have been rebalanced across all difficulties. The Sun/Star anomaly now spawns from difficulty 11 but has received an increased damage buff.  
[*] Drevnid now spawns fewer roots.  
[*] Slightly reduced Gnilokost stomp screen effect.
[*] Rebalanced character stats to ensure all characters are viable.  
[*] Reworked rewards:  
   - Different locations now offer different main objective rewards.  
   - Higher difficulties now provide better rewards.  
[*] Side objective relics are now weightless.  
[*] Kogteron now spawns from difficulty 11.  
[/list]  

[b]Fixes[/b]  
[list]
[*] Fixed various typos in localization.  
[*] Fixed an issue where Gnilokost's stomp attack sometimes affected players through walls.  
[*] Ignite and turret Exotec kills now count as player kills in the mission result window.  
[*] Fixed various errors and exceptions.  
[/list]

notes.title: What’s Coming Next
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here’s where we’re at with Patch 0.5, it’s turning into our biggest update yet. Here’s what’s coming:

[list]
[*] New difficulty levels for those who want a bigger challenge.
[*] Uber enemies - stronger versions of some existing monsters.
[*] Characters rebalancing. We’re reworking the rookie character and tweaking all characters to make sure everyone feels viable and fun to play.
[*] Active abilities. Each character is getting two active abilities, and you can pick one to use in the HUB.
[*] Rebalance and rework of various things. Some weapons, modifiers, anomalies, weight, etc.
[*] Ways to deal with duplicate modifiers besides conversion.
[*] And much more.
[/list]

Unfortunately, progress has slowed down a bit. Our artist’s HDD and SSD have both failed (it's so over), and there are some personal issues as well. Since it’s just the two of us, these things kinda suck.

We were aiming for late January for this patch, but now it’s looking more like [b]sometime in February[/b]. Things could still change depending on how smoothly everything goes. Thanks for understanding, and we’ll let you know as soon as we have more to share.

notes.title: Year-End Update: Plans and a Short Break
notes.content:
[b]Attention Operatives,[/b]

The year is almost over, and after an exciting start with C.A.S.T. in early access, it’s time for us to take a short break. From now until January 5th, we'll be resting and recharging for the new year.

During this time, we won’t be rolling out any patches unless a game-breaking bug arises. Once we’re back, we’ll dive straight into our plans for the next updates:

[b]Update 0.4.1[/b]: Focused on quality-of-life improvements, including a text chat, ping system, and other fixes and enhancements.
[b]Update 0.5.0[/b]: A major update introducing new difficulty levels alongside other exciting content.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Enjoy the holiday season, and we’ll see you in 2025 ready for more missions!

Stay safe, and happy New Year!

[b]Current Roadmap[/b]
